notes: tapFrac values are DERIVED, not guessed. UGUI targets: CanvasScaler ref 1242x2688, ScreenMatchMode Expand -> logical canvas 1242x2760 on a 1080x2400 device; the panel body sits inside an AspectRatioFitter (EnvelopeParent, 1242/2688) that resolves to 1275.27x2760, so screenX = 0.5 + (anchorX - 0.5) * 1275.27/1242 and screenY = 1 - anchorY. Board targets: ortho size 5, halfW = 5 * 1080/2400 = 2.25, board width 0.88 of the screen, pitch = 3.96/7 = 0.5657; grid 1 has 2 deflector rows, so row 0 sits at world y 1.3667.
